honest_label: post-Gold paper-derived method reconstruction with a locked implementation and prospective one-shot evaluation

evidence_sources.title: Design-time business process compliance assessment based on multi-granularity semantic information

method_claims.claim: Process model label parsing extracts business components: actions and business objects from activity and event labels; actors/actions/business objects are the semantic components of labels
method_claims.implementation: P2 extracts actor/action/business_object per activity from model context + label language analysis

method_claims.claim: A Leopold et al. (2013) technique decomposes activity/event labels using model context analysis and structural knowledge of labels; Sun employs 'a similar technique' for actions and business objects
method_claims.location: Section 4.1, paragraph on label parsing; reference [25] (Leopold 2013, PhD thesis)
method_claims.implementation: P2 implements deterministic model-context analysis (pool/lane) + structural label analysis (POS/dependency based)
method_claims.difference: Leopold 2013 PhD thesis is unavailable locally; exact style taxonomy and rules are unavailable_or_underspecified (see D-items)

method_claims.claim: Process label analysis has three steps: 1. Label Style Recognition, 2. Label Composition Analysis, 3. Semantic Content Derivation (Fig. 3)
method_claims.implementation: P2 pipeline mirrors the three steps with locked deterministic rules
method_claims.difference: per-step parameters not published; project adaptation locked in config (see D1-D4)

method_claims.claim: The majority of model information (activities, events, gateways, control flow) is explicitly contained in the process model structure (Definition 1); actors are available from model structure
method_claims.implementation: P2 actor derivation uses pool/lane model context from the frozen structural Process Record + BPMN XML lane-set mapping
method_claims.difference: none for actor context; no learned model used

method_claims.claim: Sun's language-analysis paradigm for extraction rules combines constituency parsing and dependency parsing (verb phrase, subject/object dependencies, passive nsubjpass, root verb) for rule-based concept extraction
method_claims.location: Section 4.2 (regulatory document parsing; same NLP paradigm family), Fig. 7 dependency tree example (nsubjpass aux Root advcl)
method_claims.implementation: P2 uses offline spaCy en_core_web_sm dependency parse (locked hash) with deterministic dependency rules: root verb, obj/dobj, nsubjpass, xcomp verb chains, prep.pobj merge, conj inclusion
method_claims.difference: applied to BPMN labels (text snippets) rather than regulatory sentences; rules are the minimal deterministic adaptation of the stated paradigm (see D2)

unavailable_or_underspecified.item: Leopold (2013) exact label-style taxonomy and per-style recognition rules
unavailable_or_underspecified.reason: PhD thesis not available locally (references/papers has no Leopold file); Sun defers details to [25]
unavailable_or_underspecified.adaptation: P2 locks a minimal three-style deterministic classifier (verb_style / noun_style / degenerate) based on POS evidence (Section 4.2 paradigm)
unavailable_or_underspecified.rationale: minimal, deterministic, interpretable; no learned model

unavailable_or_underspecified.item: Exact syntactic rules for action/object derivation from labels
unavailable_or_underspecified.reason: Sun states the steps 'will not be extensively discussed ... due to space limitation'
unavailable_or_underspecified.adaptation: P2 locks dependency rules: action = root verb (+ xcomp verb chain); object = obj/dobj subtree incl. internal prep pobj, conj, excl. aux/punct; passive via nsubjpass; noun-style action = first noun, object = prep pobj(s)
unavailable_or_underspecified.rationale: standard dependency-grammar formulation consistent with the stated paradigm (Fig. 7 example)

unavailable_or_underspecified.item: Tokenizer/parser/POS configuration of the original method
unavailable_or_underspecified.adaptation: locked offline spaCy 3.8.13 + en_core_web_sm 3.8.0 (dir sha256 f5c9433c...), no download, no network
unavailable_or_underspecified.rationale: only offline runtime already present in the workspace (Winter baseline uses the same model family)

unavailable_or_underspecified.item: Actor fallback policy when lane labels are empty or ambiguous
unavailable_or_underspecified.adaptation: pool-name fallback from BPMN XML lane-set mapping (empty lane -> pool; ambiguous non-empty lanes -> pool with ambiguity status; no pool -> null + no_actor)
unavailable_or_underspecified.rationale: model context analysis per C2/C4; deterministic and disclosed

project_adaptations.value: collapse unicode whitespace (same policy as locked P1); no case normalization, no lemmatization in output values
ascending activity_id ordering; canonical JSON UTF-8 sort-keys compact hashing; fail-closed on unknown baseline/invalid record/output tampering
P2 implementation/config/runner never read data/gold, human correction, adjudication assets, or Stage 3 Gold; input whitelist enforced; static + runtime guards

project_adaptations.item: No per-sample or per-label special rules
project_adaptations.value: no process_id/activity_id/Gold-value hardcoding; forbidden by contract tests

engineering_enhancements: fail-closed behavior on missing runtime or unparseable labels
independent verifier with recomputed hashes (no trusted booleans)
synthetic fixtures whose expectations derive from the method contract, not from GDPR-7 Gold
forbidden_p0_p1_mechanisms: P1 first-token surface split is NOT used anywhere inside P2 (no fallback to P1)
P0 raw-label passthrough is NOT used inside P2
any hidden fallback to P0/P1 outputs is forbidden
P2 outputs must come from the locked linguistic/model-context analysis only
claim_boundary: This is a method-level independent reconstruction (Sun/Leopold-style) with a locked implementation and prospective one-shot evaluation. It is NOT an exact reproduction, NOT Sun's original implementation, NOT a P1 enhancement, NOT a novel Stage 1 method, and NOT a blind preregistration (the lock happened after the Stage 1 Gold was formed).
